info.title: ERP-AI-Pro API
info.description: Modular ERP for Dewiride. Routes are grouped as /api/<domain>/<module>/<resource>, every response carries an X-Correlation-ID header and every error is an RFC 9457 problem document.

license.name: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 only

get.summary: Starts the Microsoft Entra sign-in and returns to the local path afterwards; a signed-in caller goes straight to that path.

parameters.name: returnUrl
parameters.description: Local path of the page to open once signed in, such as /platform/attachments; the home page when omitted.

post.summary: Ends the session, when the request carries one, and redirects to the Microsoft Entra end-session endpoint, which returns to the sign-in page.

get.summary: Issues the signed-in person's antiforgery tokens again: the request token in the readable cookie __Host-erp-xsrf, sent back in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.
Returns the signed-in person: their Microsoft Entra ID object id, display name, sign-in name and app roles, and the permissions their roles give them.
Returns when the session ends unless a request renews it and when it ends at the latest, without renewing it.

post.summary: Renews the session at once, for the idle timeout from now within the session lifetime, and returns when it ends.

get.summary: Returns the application name, version and uptime of the API.
Lists the most recent starts of the API, newest first.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: How many starts to return, between 1 and 100; 20 when the caller does not ask.

get.summary: Lists stored attachments, newest first unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Stores one file sent as a multipart/form-data part with a file name.

requestBody.description: The file, as the single part of a multipart/form-data body that carries a file name.

get.summary: Describes the largest file and the media types an upload may have.
Describes one stored attachment.

delete.summary: Deletes an attachment; its download links stop working.

post.summary: Creates a short-lived link that downloads the attachment for the person asking.

get.summary: Streams the original file for a valid, unexpired link of the person asking.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Token of a download link created for this attachment by the person downloading it.

get.summary: Lists the recorded changes, newest first unless the caller sorts them, with the names their actors, records and references have today.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Streams the recorded changes the filter selects as a CSV file, oldest first, with one line per changed value.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the list of changes allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |. Absent, every change is exported.

get.summary: Lists the people of the ERP, by display name unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Registers a person by work email before their first sign-in, which links the record to their Entra account.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one person.

put.summary: Changes the employee code, phone number and date of joining of a person.

delete.summary: Deletes a person's record; their sessions end at their next request.

put.summary: Deactivates or reactivates a person; a deactivated person cannot sign in, and their sessions end at their next request.
Replaces the roles a person holds in the ERP, Finance, HR and Manager; their next request holds the new ones.

get.summary: Searches the company directory in Microsoft Entra on the administrator's behalf and names the people the ERP already holds.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text to look for at the start of a word of a person's display name, or at the start of their email address or user principal name: at most 100 characters, at least 2 of them besides spaces at either end, without & or control characters.

post.summary: Registers a person of the company directory by their Entra object id, with the name and sign-in name the directory holds, so their first sign-in finds the record.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Lists the active people who have joined by a date, with the department, designation and manager of the position each holds on it, today unless the caller names another.

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Date whose chart to read, in India; absent reads today's. Another date than today needs the permission identity.users.positions.read.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

get.summary: Lists the departments, by name unless the caller sorts them; each names the department it sits under.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Creates a department at the top of the tree or under another.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one department.

put.summary: Renames a department, or moves it under another department or to the top of the tree.

delete.summary: Deletes a department that has no departments within it and that no position names today or from a later date.

get.summary: Lists the designations, by name unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Adds a designation to the list positions choose from.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one designation.

delete.summary: Deletes a designation that no position names today or from a later date.

get.summary: Lists a person's positions, the latest first unless the caller sorts them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1; the first page when absent.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 200; 50 when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated field:asc or field:desc terms over the fields the endpoint allows.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Semicolon-separated field:operator:value terms over the fields the endpoint allows; values are percent-encoded and an in-list separates its values with |.

post.summary: Records a person's position from a date, in the past or the future, until their next position starts.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A UUID chosen by the client for this request; repeating the request with the same key replays the first response instead of acting twice.

get.summary: Describes one of a person's positions.

delete.summary: Withdraws one of a person's positions; the one before it then holds until the next starts.

get.summary: Returns every feature flag of the catalog with its evaluated state.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP from now on, in place of those they held; their app roles in Microsoft Entra give them Administrator and Employee besides.

version.description: Version of the record the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

status.description: Status the record takes: a deactivated person cannot sign in, and their open sessions end at their next request.

version.description: Version of the record the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

name.description: Name of the department, unique among the departments under the same parent.

parentId.description: Department it sits under; absent places it at the top of the tree.

name.description: Name of the designation, unique among the designations.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; the type member is this code under /problems/.

traceId.description: Correlation id of the request, the same value the X-Correlation-ID response header carries.

entraObjectId.description: Entra object id of the person in the company directory, as the directory search returned it.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP besides Administrator and Employee, which come from their app roles in Microsoft Entra; naming any needs the permission identity.users.people.assign-roles.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code; the type member is this code under /problems/.

traceId.description: Correlation id of the request, the same value the X-Correlation-ID response header carries.

effectiveFrom.description: Date the position starts, in the past or the future; it holds until the date the person's next position starts.

departmentId.description: Department the person is in from that date; absent puts them in none.

designationId.description: Designation the person holds from that date; absent gives them none.

managerId.description: Person they report to from that date, never themself; absent gives them no manager.

displayName.description: Name the ERP shows for the person until their first sign-in brings the one Entra keeps.

workEmail.description: Work email of the person, which their first sign-in matches to link the record to their Entra account.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company.

roles.description: Roles the person holds in the ERP besides Administrator and Employee, which come from their app roles in Microsoft Entra; naming any needs the permission identity.users.people.assign-roles.

name.description: Name of the department, unique among the departments under the same parent.

parentId.description: Department it sits under from now on, never itself or one within it; absent moves it to the top of the tree.

version.description: Version of the department the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

name.description: Name of the designation, unique among the designations; every position that names it shows the new name.

version.description: Version of the designation the change was made from, as the API last returned it.

employeeCode.description: Employee code: letters, digits, hyphens, slashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit, unique among the people of the ERP; empty clears it.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number: an international number starting with + and its country code, or a 10-digit Indian mobile number; empty clears it.

dateOfJoining.description: Date the person joined the company; absent clears it.

version.description: Version of the record the edit was made from, as the API last returned it.

SessionCookie.description: The session cookie __Host-erp-session, HttpOnly and Secure, which the API sets once a Microsoft Entra ID sign-in started at /api/auth/login completes; a browser sends it on every request to this origin.
SessionCookie.name: __Host-erp-session

AntiforgeryToken.description: The value of the readable cookie __Host-erp-xsrf, required with the session cookie on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE it signs in, which otherwise answer 400 antiforgery.token-missing or antiforgery.token-invalid; GET /api/auth/antiforgery issues it again, and POST /api/auth/logout also takes it in the form field __RequestVerificationToken.
AntiforgeryToken.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
